items.title: Sudhalter interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2020
items.q: And you know Joe Tranchina, he’s our house pianist, and he made me a track, he sent it to me, I played along with it on this tune.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think the things you see with orchestras playing together, I believe they must have some really high tech things going on there.

Yeah. There’s stuff you can buy. But we did a good one at the last jam. I did, on baritone sax I did “I’ll Walk Alone.” And you know Joe Tranchina, he’s our house pianist, and he made me a track, he sent it to me, I played along with it on this tune. Then he sent it to the drummer and the bass player and they played a track. And then Joe did a beautiful mix. He lined them up, this took him a few hours. And you can hear it, you know, if you go on that recording of the last jam. It came out so sweet, really, really…
Ah. That’s a good way to put it.
